cases.name: clean-frozen-install
cases.precondition: Exact clean checkout with Node 24.19.0 and pnpm 11.21.0.
cases.oracle: Checked-in lockfile installs without mutation or resolution drift.

cases.name: strict-typecheck
cases.oracle: Shared packages and all four apps pass strict type checks.

cases.name: independent-static-builds
cases.oracle: Each app independently produces static build output without a production Node server.

cases.name: package-boundaries-and-cycles
cases.oracle: No missing/extra boundary, app-to-app dependency, package-to-app dependency, undeclared workspace import, or cycle exists.

cases.name: code-splitting-static-output
cases.oracle: Nginx-deliverable HTML exists and each React app contains a dynamic route chunk.

cases.name: no-production-node-runtime
cases.precondition: Exact tracked tree and package scripts are available.
cases.oracle: No production Docker/Compose, PM2, Node server, Vite preview, Astro preview, SSR serve/start path is introduced.

cases.name: lockfile-and-dependency-inventory
cases.precondition: Checked-in pnpm-lock.yaml and all workspace manifests exist.
cases.oracle: Lockfile version, pinned foundation versions and workspace dependency inventory are reproducible and recorded.
